crossRefs.note: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember…
It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me…
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
“Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic…

translations.web: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
translations.bsb: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
translations.kjv: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
translations.asv: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.
